items.title: Puerto Vallarta airport confirms Tuesday reopening after Simon closure
items.summary: Puerto Vallarta International Airport (PVR) confirmed via its own social-media update that all types of operations, including commercial flights, will be permitted again starting Tuesday, Oct 13, after closing Sat Oct 10 (~6 PM local) ahead of Hurricane Simon. Resumption is gradual and airline-by-airline; travelers must confirm flight status with airlines before heading to the terminal. Air Canada and WestJet lifted their flexible travel advisories for affected passengers. Corroborated by travelmonitor.com.au's Oct-13 daily watch (scheduled 8 AM local reopening) and Drive Mexico Magazine/La Jornada (GAP's 12:01 AM Tuesday plan). Manzanillo's reopening remains unconfirmed.
items.source_name: Travel Market Report (trade press citing the airport's own social announcement)
